# TRANSFORMING ENERGY INTO OPPORTUNITY 

# We revolutionize energy management with an AI-powered OASES™ optimization software, providing
# advanced solutions that optimize renewable energy and storage portfolios.

# By leveraging cutting-edge technology and data analytics, we empower our clients to make informed
# decisions that enhance both sustainability and profitability. Through collaboration and
# innovation, we are shaping the future of clean energy and smart grid solutions.

The renewable energy management market is transforming rapidly, driven by increased demand,
technological advancements, and evolving regulatory landscape.

However,  significant challenges remain.  Fragmented market and a lack of standardization, limiting
flexibility and scalability for energy providers. Rapid shifts in policies, business models, and
revenue streams make investment decisions more complex.

The integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DER) and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) adds
complexity to grid management due to intermittency and the need for  advanced
forecasting,   real-time monitoring,  and  optimization. 

# OASES is Shaping Tomorrow’s Energy, Today

OASES

Energy Management

and Optimization System

Photovoltaics

Battery storage

Microgrids

Wind turbines

EV charging stations

By continuously analyzing multiple factors in real time, our AI-powered solution ensures grid
stability while maximizing economic returns.

[Request a meeting ][7]

## Intelligent Optimization for Renewable Energy

[Oases_product_2_4.png]

###### Cloud-Based
###### & Modular

Flexible platform with SCADA edge controller for seamless integration

###### Comprehensive Asset Optimization

Optimizes photovoltaics, battery storage, microgrids, wind turbines, and EV charging

###### Cost Reduction & Revenue Maximization

Enhances efficiency through forecasting, optimization, and automated bidding

###### AI-Driven Market Participation

Leverages AI for smart energy trading

###### Digital Twin Technology

Enables precise planning, sizing, and sustainable operations

## Unlock the Full Potential of Your Energy Assets Through

###### Limitless Universal Optimizer

Real-time computation and revenue maximization for diverse energy assets using a combination of
physics-based modelling and AI

###### Flexible Configuration Engine

User friendly visual scripting language enables real-time customization without complex programming,
supporting any use case and regulatory changes

###### Open Architecture

Vendor-agnostic implementation and collaboration with other solutions for maximum flexibility and
scalability

###### End-to-End Platform

Comprehensive solution that starts from planning and sizing all the way towards real-time revenue
optimization and deep analytics

###### Cyber and IoT Expertise

Leveraging strong experience in cybersecurity and hardware-software integration to protect your
assets and ensure grid stability

[Request a meeting ][8]

## What Our Customers Say About Us

[Yaki Noyman.png]

###### Yaki Noyman

###### CEO of Doral Energy

###### "

At Doral, we continuously seek cutting-edge technologies that align with our vision for a cleaner
energy future and enhance the performance of our extensive portfolio of storage-integrated PV power
plants. BrightSource’s EMS technology offers advanced capabilities that support our mission to
optimize energy storage and generation while maintaining grid reliability.

###### "

BrightSource in Numbers

# 700 MW

# 300+ MW

# 3

## With BrightSource You Get

###### Leadership in Energy

BrightSource Energy has led energy generation and optimization for over 20 years, delivering
innovative, efficient, and sustainable renewable energy solutions globally

###### Deep Expertise

Over the years, BrightSource Energy gained deep expertise in software engineering, algorithm
development, weather forecasting, energy modeling and optimization

###### Proven Track Record

BrightSource Energy has a history of successful large-scale projects, demonstrating its ability to
deliver on time and within budget

## Powering Profitability, Energizing the Future

# TRANSFORMING ENERGY INTO OPPORTUNITY 

# We revolutionize energy management with an AI-powered OASES™ optimization software, providing
# advanced solutions that optimize renewable energy and storage portfolios.

# By leveraging cutting-edge technology and data analytics, we empower our clients to make informed
# decisions that enhance both sustainability and profitability. Through collaboration and
# innovation, we are shaping the future of clean energy and smart grid solutions.

The renewable energy management market is transforming rapidly, driven by increased demand,
technological advancements, and evolving regulatory landscape.

However,  significant challenges remain.  Fragmented market and a lack of standardization, limiting
flexibility and scalability for energy providers. Rapid shifts in policies, business models, and
revenue streams make investment decisions more complex.

The integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DER) and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) adds
complexity to grid management due to intermittency and the need for  advanced
forecasting,   real-time monitoring,  and  optimization. 

# OASES is Shaping Tomorrow’s Energy, Today

# 
# Powering Today. Building Tomorrow.™

[Green horizontal line.]

 

## 100+ Years of Powering Progress

For more than a century, we’ve delivered stable, secure and scalable power solutions that revitalize
communities with new investments, new jobs and new purpose.

[Powering today. Building tomorrow]
[x][27]

## NextEra Energy is
## Delivering for America

Grids don’t build or modernize themselves, and resilience doesn’t happen by chance. It happens when
you advance with purpose. NextEra Energy is always building — power plants of all kinds,
infrastructure to fuel them and the network to move the power they generate from coast to coast. 

 

### FPL: Shaping Florida's Energy Future

As America's largest electric utility, Florida Power & Light Company serves more than 6 million
accounts, providing electricity to around 12 million people in Florida. Known for its fuel- and
cost-efficient power generation, FPL focuses on keeping bills low while driving energy innovation
and reliability. FPL is leading the way in supporting Florida’s growth with continuous
infrastructure advancements.

[Visit FPL][28]

### NextEra Energy Resources: An Energy Pioneer

NextEra Energy Resources is advancing America’s energy future with the largest and most diverse
portfolio of power generation and infrastructure solutions. As one of the nation's top wholesale
generators of electric power, it leverages all forms of energy across renewables, storage, natural
gas and nuclear. NextEra Energy Resources offers a wide range of integrated solutions to help
utilities and businesses across the country meet their energy needs when and where they need it.

[Visit NextEra Energy Resources][29]

### **We build and operate all forms of energy **

[diverse energy mix white outline icon]

**America's leading energy infrastructure builder**

[florida map white outline icon]

**Owner and operator of the largest electric utility in the U.S.**

[solar panels white outline icon]

**World leader in renewables¹**

[battery white outline icon]

**World leader in battery storage**

[nuclear symbol white outline]

**Operates one of America's largest nuclear fleets**

[electrical distribution lines white outline icon]

**America's leading transmission utility and leading competitive transmission developer**

[bar chart increase white outline icon]

**Better than top-decile operations across wind, solar, fossil and nuclear**

[ai artificial intelligence white outline icon]

**Industry leader in artificial intelligence and technology**

[Learn more][30]

### In Our Community

Across our company, more than 17,000 employees are actively giving back to the community. Whether
it's volunteering at local events or supporting animals in need, our people lead with heart. It’s
all part of our commitment to making a positive impact where we live and work.

### Join the Next Era

Discover your next opportunity at the forefront of the energy industry. Be part of a team that
powers American homes, businesses and dreams, now and in the future.

[Explore Careers][31]

Stay updated with the latest on company milestones, and how NextEra Energy is shaping the future of
power. 

[FPL and Dominion Energy bucket trucks]

regulated electric utility business.****

[NextEra Energy logo]

NextEra Energy to Develop up to 10 GW of Natural Gas Powered Generation

NextEra Energy announced President Donald J. Trump has approved the development of up to 10

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

Welcome to **Appropedia**, the sustainability wiki!

Rocket stoves

## Our service

We help individuals and organizations produce, publish and spread knowledge focused on poverty
reduction and sustainability.

[Contact us!][78]

But why Appropedia?
* **Vision-driven** — Imagine a world where every human being can live rich and sustainable lives.
  Does this resonate with you or your organization? If so, we'd love to help you!
* **Free and open** — Appropedia is and always will be free to access and with open licenses.
* **Advanced tools** — We've been documenting projects since 2006! In the process we developed
  powerful yet simple to use tools and standards.
* **Accessibility** — We strive to make content in Appropedia available to everyone. Appropedia can
  be accessed offline via [Kiwix][79] as well as plain prints and books, can be easily read aloud
  for visually-impaired (or busy) people, translated to many languages, accessed via APIs, and more!
* **No overhead** — Start documenting right away without having to worry about developers, domains,
  hosting, setup, configuration or maintenance.
* **Resilience** — Keeping content online indefinitely is hard. According to various studies, most

  but is determined to be sustainable itself!

## Our service

We help individuals and organizations produce, publish and spread knowledge focused on poverty
reduction and sustainability.

[Contact us!][78]

But why Appropedia?
* **Vision-driven** — Imagine a world where every human being can live rich and sustainable lives.
  Does this resonate with you or your organization? If so, we'd love to help you!
* **Free and open** — Appropedia is and always will be free to access and with open licenses.
* **Advanced tools** — We've been documenting projects since 2006! In the process we developed
  powerful yet simple to use tools and standards.
* **Accessibility** — We strive to make content in Appropedia available to everyone. Appropedia can
  be accessed offline via [Kiwix][79] as well as plain prints and books, can be easily read aloud
  for visually-impaired (or busy) people, translated to many languages, accessed via APIs, and more!
* **No overhead** — Start documenting right away without having to worry about developers, domains,
  hosting, setup, configuration or maintenance.
* **Resilience** — Keeping content online indefinitely is hard. According to various studies, most
  links break after only two or three years. Appropedia not only hosts content about sustainability,
  but is determined to be sustainable itself!
* **Strong SEO** — Take advantage of our many years online and hundreds of thousands of backlinks to
  see your content rise to the top of search results in no time.
* **Community support** — You're not alone! [Leave a message anytime][80] and we'll do our best to
  help you!
* **Exit button** — If you ever want to leave or copy your content elsewhere, we provide tools to do
  so.

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

[ [Phil Harvey's headshot] ][27]
[Phil Harvey][28] Editor-in-Chief

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and

### **Why CSPU is a Breakthrough Investment**

**We are in the business of generating solar electricity economically.**

Concentrating Solar Power Utility (CSPU) delivers the world’s first affordable, rooftop-ready solar
collector capable of achieving 300–350 C, ***Patent Pending.***
* Each CSPU solar collector produces approximately 1,900 kWh of high-temperature thermal energy per
  year (300–350°C process heat).
* At a projected manufacturing cost of approximately $1,000 per unit and a conservative 25-year
  operating life, the lifetime thermal energy output is roughly 47,500 kWh.

That results in a levelized cost of thermal energy of approximately:
* ~$0.02 per kWh (2 cents per kWh thermal)
* This compares favorably to:
* Natural gas: typically $0.04–0.08 per kWh thermal
* Electric resistance heating: typically $0.15–0.25 per kWh

If paired with an ORC or Stirling engine for power generation, each unit can additionally produce
approximately 380 kWh of electricity per year, while still delivering usable industrial-grade heat.

**The key distinction is that CSPU delivers high-temperature industrial heat directly, which
conventional solar PV systems cannot provide. It can also integrate with thermal storage for
dispatchable energy use without battery systems.**

#### **The massive untapped solar air conditioning market is driving homeowners, data centers, and
#### industry to increasingly seek clean energy solutions beyond electricity production.**

CSPU delivers the world’s first affordable, rooftop-ready solar collector capable of achieving
300–350 C, enabling zero-electricity cooling for homes, businesses, and industry. With global
cooling demand set to triple by 2050 and electricity-driven air conditioning becoming unsustainable,
CSPU enters a $500 billion emerging clean-cooling market with a patented, defensible technology and
a 100-year system lifespan.

Solar-powered air conditioning is one of the largest untapped markets in renewable energy. By 2030,
cooling is expected to exceed 10 percent of global electricity consumption. Over one billion new air
conditioners will be installed within fifteen years, almost all powered by fossil-fueled
electricity.

CSPU enables cooling directly from sunlight – no electricity, no compressors, no grid load. Silent,
clean, fuel-free cooling dramatically reduces energy bills and provides resilience during grid
failures. No flat plate collector today can reach the 300–350 C temperature range required for
absorption cooling.

CSPU is the first affordable, rooftop-ready design capable of reaching these temperatures, opening a
multi-billion-dollar global clean-cooling market.

## Welcome to Common Wholesale Platform & Common Switching Platform

## About

### Why Common Wholesale Platform?

CWP/CSP is a central hub that serves all the UK telecom industry (directly or via other hubs) for:

> 1) Common Wholesale Platform (CWP) to wholesale: significantly accelerate gigabit adoption in the
> UK by making multiple Access Communications Provider (ACP) networks visible to contracted retail
> communication provider (RCP) resellers in one central location. The platform also facilitates
> universal standard CWP reference products to scale RCP providers. These standards allow you to
> comply with BDUK Project Gigabit wholesale requirements.

> 2) Common Switching Platform (CSP) for retailers to comply with consumer One Touch Switching (OTS)
> and business Gaining Provider led-Business (GPL-B) Ofcom regulated processes: CWP serves as a Full
> Management Managed Access Provider ( MAP) to the OTS hub which allows you to comply with Ofcom OTS
> and GPL-B obligations and simplify the integration process. As a Full Management MAP we carry out
> all the integrations with TOTSCo for you, so you don’t have to; and support you in your
> integration to CWP.

[More][11]

## Services

### The features of our service

You can manage RCP and ACP roles and users on our secure platform. ACPs can manage products for
resale by RCPs and share their coverage map with contracted RCPs. Its open API and web GUI are used
for new orders & switch orders alike. RCPs can lookup products available to a **[Unique Property
Reference (UPRN)][12]**. The platform includes audit trails for all transactions and detailed
reporting […]

[CWP for wholesalers][13]
[CSP for retailers][14]

## Joining CWP

Joining CWP as a member is easy. There are options to join as a network access communications
provider (ACP), a gigabit connectivity retail communications provider (RCP) or both. We have
different membership tiers depending on the amount of gaining transactions (for an ACP) and the
number of customers (for an RCP). During setup we will help you to get your business support systems
integrated with CWP. Please [contact us][15] if you wish to join.

[Join CWP][16]

## Contact CWP

We are located at 7 Bell Yard, London, WC2A 2JR!

You can use our contact form to request more information from us.

with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.

collaborate with.

At Heliogen, we envision a world where breakthrough long-duration energy storage empowers the
future. By harnessing the limitless power of natural resources and converting it into
always-available, dispatchable energy, we provide data centers, oil & gas, minerals & processing
facilities with clean, reliable power—when you need it most.

Our mission is to unlock a carbon-free energy future where innovation is never limited by the grid,
and uptime is guaranteed by nature’s most abundant resource.

[homepage-hero-image]

## **A Range of Practical Power Solutions**

Heliogen is an energy technology company specializing in unlocking the power of the sun for
cost-effective, reliable, and dispatchable low-carbon power and heat.

We work closely with our customers to evaluate ways to select and design power systems that achieve
balance between decarbonization goals, capital investment, and operating costs. By combining
advanced solar technologies, long duration energy storage, and our thermal systems expertise, we

performance, availability, and scale you can count on.

energy (concentrated solar and photovoltaics) and molten salt thermal energy storage, designed to
optimize performance and sustainability.

## Empowering Indonesia’s green future: leXsolar and PT BUANA PRIMA RAYA support the RENEWABLE
## ENERGY SKILLS DEVELOPMENT (RESD) program!  

Show more

We are thrilled to announce that [leXsolar GmbH][21], in close partnership with @PT BUANA PRIMA
RAYA, is officially supporting the RENEWABLE ENERGY SKILLS DEVELOPMENT (RESD) in Indonesia!

 

The Renewable Energy Skills Development Project aims at supporting the expansion of renewable energy
in Indonesia. The [GFA Consulting Group GmbH][22] in partnership with the SECO - State Secretariat
for Economic Affairs in Switzerland, implement international development and economic cooperation
projects and aims to build a highly skilled workforce to accelerate Indonesia’s energy transition
toward net zero emissions by 2060.

 

As a leading provider of renewable energy training systems, leXsolar, together with our local
partner PT BUANA PRIMA RAYA, is proud to equip polytechnics and vocational training centers across
Indonesia with PV training solutions. Through hands-on, industry-standard learning, we are
empowering the next generation of Indonesian green technicians and engineers.

 

Thank you to PT BUANA PRIMA RAYA and the program’s implementation teams for making this impactful
collaboration possible. Together, we are shaping the future of sustainable education!

### Three-Row Roller Slewing Bearing (13 Series)

The three-row roller slewing bearing (Series 13) adopts a functional division design with a
three-row roller structure, which not only enables efficient load transmission but also provides a
larger load-bearing area. The inner and outer rows of rollers mainly bear axial loads, while the
middle row is dedicated to withstanding radial loads.

The arrangement of the rollers is precisely calculated to achieve uniform load distribution,
minimizing the risk of premature wear or deformation caused by uneven load distribution. The
accurate alignment and high-precision machining process of the rollers ensure the contact precision
between the raceways and rollers, allowing the bearing to maintain smooth and stable rotational
operation under various working conditions

[Double-Row Equal-Diameter Four-Point Contact Ball Slewing Bearing]

### Double-Row Equal-Diameter Four-Point Contact Ball Slewing Bearing

The double-row equal-diameter four-point contact ball slewing bearing ingeniously combines the
double-row ball layout with the four-point contact principle, achieving an excellent balance among
anti-overturning moment capacity, structural compactness, and comprehensive load-bearing
performance.

Its structural feature lies in that the rolling elements (steel balls) are in four-point contact
with the raceways, and all rolling elements maintain the same diameter. This design enables the
bearing to simultaneously withstand multi-directional loads such as axial loads, radial loads and
overturning moments. It boasts high rigidity and stability, making it suitable for various
heavy-duty application scenarios.

The double-row ball design increases the number of contact points, which can not only distribute the
load and reduce the pressure on individual steel balls, thereby extending the service life of the
bearing, but also endow the bearing with excellent performance under complex load conditions thanks
to its four-point contact structure. It is particularly applicable to equipment that needs to bear
multi-directional loads at the same time. In addition, this structure can effectively reduce the
occurrence of rolling element slippage, further enhancing the rigidity and operational stability of
the bearing.

[Single Row Cross-Roller Slewing Bearing]

### Single Row Cross-Roller Slewing Bearing

The single-row crossed roller slewing bearing adopts cylindrical rollers to provide line contact,
whose load-carrying capacity is far higher than that of ball bearings with point contact of the same
size. The roller axes are arranged in an "X-cross" pattern inside the bearing. Half of the rollers
bear axial forces, while the other half (crossed with them) bear radial forces; however, they form
an integrated unit and work in coordination. This structure not only improves the load-carrying
capacity of the bearing, but also enhances the operational stability of the equipment.

The raceways usually adopt a "V-shape" or "flat surface + rib" design. One raceway surface is used
to withstand axial loads, and the other vertical surface is used to withstand radial loads. The
precise fit between the rollers and raceways ensures high precision and stability during slewing
operations. The inner and outer rings are usually of integral or split type, featuring a more
compact structure.

With a flexible mounting design, the single-row crossed roller slewing bearing can meet the diverse
needs of users, and can be easily installed either horizontally or vertically.

[Single-Row Ball Slewing Bearing]

### Single-Row Ball Slewing Bearing

The single-row ball slewing bearing is a bearing product specially designed for slewing motion, with
a single row of steel balls as rolling elements. Its raceways are specially designed to enable the
steel balls to form two-point or four-point contact with the raceways, thereby achieving the
capacity to withstand multi-directional loads. 

The inner and outer rings usually adopt a split design (one integral ring and one split ring) for
easy steel ball installation; integral designs are also available but less common. The steel balls
are high-precision ones with a single row and equal diameter, combined with advanced heat treatment
technology. They exhibit excellent performance in withstanding axial and radial loads, and can
easily cope with various complex working conditions. 

There are two main types of raceway shapes:

Four-point contact ball type: It adopts a Gothic arch raceway, which is the most common and
representative single-row ball slewing bearing. The steel balls form four-point contact with this
type of raceway in all directions. 

Two-point angular contact type: The raceway cross-section is arc-shaped, and the steel balls form
two-point contact with the raceway at a certain contact angle (e.g., 45°). It is mainly used in
situations where combined loads are borne with axial loads as the primary component. 

The precisely machined ball raceway design ensures an extremely low friction coefficient during
bearing operation, making the slewing process smoother and more flexible, and effectively reducing
energy consumption. Manufactured from high-wear-resistant materials, this bearing can maintain
excellent performance and a long service life even under high-load and long-term operating
conditions. 

To adapt to different operating environments, the single-row ball slewing bearing offers a variety
of sealing solutions, which can ensure its performance under various working conditions and
effectively prevent the intrusion of dust and moisture.

operations. The inner and outer rings are usually of integral or split type, featuring a more
compact structure.

needs of users, and can be easily installed either horizontally or vertically.

[Single-Row Ball Slewing Bearing]

### Single-Row Ball Slewing Bearing

The single-row ball slewing bearing is a bearing product specially designed for slewing motion, with
a single row of steel balls as rolling elements. Its raceways are specially designed to enable the
steel balls to form two-point or four-point contact with the raceways, thereby achieving the
capacity to withstand multi-directional loads. 

The inner and outer rings usually adopt a split design (one integral ring and one split ring) for
easy steel ball installation; integral designs are also available but less common. The steel balls
are high-precision ones with a single row and equal diameter, combined with advanced heat treatment
technology. They exhibit excellent performance in withstanding axial and radial loads, and can
easily cope with various complex working conditions. 

There are two main types of raceway shapes:

Four-point contact ball type: It adopts a Gothic arch raceway, which is the most common and
representative single-row ball slewing bearing. The steel balls form four-point contact with this
type of raceway in all directions. 

Two-point angular contact type: The raceway cross-section is arc-shaped, and the steel balls form
two-point contact with the raceway at a certain contact angle (e.g., 45°). It is mainly used in
situations where combined loads are borne with axial loads as the primary component. 

The precisely machined ball raceway design ensures an extremely low friction coefficient during
bearing operation, making the slewing process smoother and more flexible, and effectively reducing
energy consumption. Manufactured from high-wear-resistant materials, this bearing can maintain
excellent performance and a long service life even under high-load and long-term operating
conditions. 

To adapt to different operating environments, the single-row ball slewing bearing offers a variety
of sealing solutions, which can ensure its performance under various working conditions and
effectively prevent the intrusion of dust and moisture.

# Storing the sun's energy during the day,

# Powering Australia overnight

Concentrated Solar Power (CSP) is a technology that can generate 100% renewable energy, replacing
night-time electricity generation currently provided by coal-and gas-fired power plants.

## Why Solar Thermal ?

Managing climate change will require countries to transition from fossil fuels to renewables.
Australia has begun its transition, but is still highly reliant on fossil fuels for electricity
generation, particularly overnight.

The cheapest forms of renewable energy, namely solar PV and wind, are variable - so the amount of
energy they can produce depends on the amount of sunlight or the strength of the wind. This creates
a number of problems:

## The Challenge

## The Solution

Electricity systems need a firm and stable supply of electricity to meet the 24/7 demand of
households and businesses.

Concentrated Solar Power (CSP) can provide a firm and stable supply of renewable electricity
overnight - from sunset to sunrise.

Solar PV and wind cannot provide the nighttime stability required to meet Australia’s needs.

CSP concentrates the daytime heat energy from the sun, which is then stored and used to produce
multiple-hours of renewable electricity overnight.

Coal fired power plants currently meet most of Australia’s need for firm and stable supply of
electricity, particularly overnight.

CSP’s long-duration thermal energy storage (TES) is used to run a steam turbine in the same way as
that used at a coal-fired power plant, and is 100% renewable.

Battery storage linked to Solar PV and wind can address some of the problem, but batteries are only
cost effective for several hours, and are cost prohibitive for overnight requirements.

CSP can displace all forms of fossil fired generation outside of daytime hours - which is the
missing piece in Australia’s low emission, high penetration renewable energy future.

## On-Demand Renewable Energy

CSP systems convert sunlight into multiple hours of thermal energy storage (TES). This energy is
then used at a later time to generate power, meaning CSP can dispatch power overnight, or at anytime
during the day when there is insufficient sun or wind.

CSP is used to complement Solar PV and wind as part of an integrated low-cost energy system. Solar
PV and wind, with several hours of battery storage, can provide low-cost renewable power during the
day, with CSP providing firm and secure power overnight when the sun has stopped shining and the
wind is intermittent. This integrated system will deliver the lowest aggregate cost to consumers,
while maintaining system security and reliability, with zero emissions.

## **How It Works**

[
Read the Full Report
Read the Full Report
][8]

CSP systems use mirrors to concentrate sunlight by up to 1000 times its normal intensity. The
concentrated sunlight, in the form of heat, is then transferred into a molten salt thermal energy
storage (TES) system. The heat in the TES is used for between 12 to 15 hours to run a steam turbine
with a synchronous generator for power production. CSP's synchronous generator allows the system to
deliver the essential grid support services – inertia, system strength and frequency control –
currently provided by coal and gas generators.

## **Australia’s Future Energy Supply **

Australia can produce more solar energy per m2 than any other country in the world. We have the
solar resource, it’s just a matter of storing it.

Solar PV can be coupled with batteries to provide a storage solution, but these battery systems are
only cost effective for several hours of energy storage. CSP is one of only a few technology options
that offers long-duration (12-15 hours) intra-day renewable energy storage that is emissions-free.
Pumped Hydro is another option, but it relies on stored water which is scarce and unreliable beyond
our coastal mountain ranges. We need access to a technology that complements solar PV and wind, by
providing a source of firm, secure, long-duration power generation overnight. CSP is the renewable
option that delivers the lowest cost, emissions-free overnight power generation, and allows the
removal of coal and gas from the grid.

The sun falling on 1% of Australia’s landmass (75,000Km2) provides enough energy to meet 30 times
Australia’s electricity needs.

AEMO’s 2022 ISP highlights that coal fired-power generation assets are exiting the market sooner
than expected, creating a gap in firm and stable power generation, particularly overnight.

Generating renewable power overnight, to replace coal fired power plants, will require significant
investment in energy storage.

In countries with high solar radiation like Australia, CSP is one of the most cost effective forms
of  longer duration energy storage for renewable power generation overnight.

## SunInfra Solutions

If you are planning to adopt Solar energy to save on your cost of electricity or to meet your
sustainability goals, we have a customized solution for your needs.

#### On Site Solar

Solar Power Plants installed in the same premises as the consumption. Solar panels could be
installed over the Rooftop, Car Park, Special Structure, Ground or a Water Body

#### Solar Farm

Solar Plants installed with Open Access are a great option for Industries to procure power at lesser
tariff than their existing Discom tariff.

#### Energy Storage

These help to store the Solar Energy and use it on demand or even create a standalone Solar run
Industry or Household as and when required.

#### BIPV (Building Integrated Solar Photovoltaic)

Install Solar panels as the building material to generate power from your building roof, skylights
or facades. PV glass is used as a building material plus as an energy-generating device.

## Who We Are

UTOPIO is a minority-owned American renewable energy technology and design company. Founded in 2017,
UTOPIO is headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey with offices in New York and Georgia.

We’re not your typical energy company. UTOPIO utilizes innovative and disruptive renewable
technologies to satisfy our client's specific needs.

The exceptionally high temperatures we produce:
* Create heat and storage that ensure consistent electricity supply
* Produce broad spectrum industrial process heat 
* Generate green hydrogen efficiently through thermolysis
* Reclaim and desalinate waste and salt water

UTOPIO is the future of energy – an affordable and sustainable solution to providing carbon neutral
(if not negative) energy and water that is affordable and reliable.

[Learn More ][13]

## Our Industry Partnerships

UTOPIO ASC has the network and reach in the energy industry. Our partnerships with the National
Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), the Solar Energy Industry Association (SEIA), and the City
College of New York (CCNY) give us the ability to forge relationships with key players in the space,
stay informed of cutting-edge research, and gain insight into the latest solar energy deals.
1. UTOPIO ASC has nurtured varied relationships in the industry.
2. The UTOPIO ASC power plants are easy to assemble, to low cost, low risk and reproducible.


[See our Partnerships/Relationships here ][14]

## UTOPIO Difference


Our disruptive technology improved over decades of mechanical engineering design research... this
ASC technology is protected by 16 internationally registered patents.


UTOPIO ASC powered by ASC technology produces 3x the heat on only 20% of the land required by
traditional CSP technologies (Parabolic Trough / Solar Tower) and 33% of the land required for PV
(photovoltaic) resulting in significantly lower CAPEX and operational costs while featuring
modularity and scalability.


While existing CSP technologies (including Heliostat Towers, Linear Troughs, and Parabolic Troughs)
are only cost-effective at utility-level applications, UTOPIO ASC powered by ASC technology is
uniquely modular and scalable. This allows us to effectively and affordably power industrial and
microgrid projects as small as 30kW to as large as 50MW. This technology affords reliable and
cost-effective power solutions to individual factories, hotels, remote installations, etc.


The modular nature of our projects not only requires significantly less acreage to produce a given
amount of energy and heat, but the land need not be contiguous. Thus, construction and operation on
terrains, such as rocky hillsides, coastal easements, non-contiguous municipal lots, etc., opens up
broader opportunities previously unobtainable by CSP.

## ASC

The ASC is a new technology in Solar Energy that combines the advantages of PV and CSP while
eliminating the problems.

[Read More ][15]

## ASC Solution
* ASC's technology provides the industrial process heating capabilities of conventional CSP coupled
  with the modularity of PV (photovoltaic).
* Ultra-high solar efficiency with a solar-electrical conversion between 40%-50%, the highest in
  history.
* Low-cost long duration energy storage for 24/7/365 production.
* Uses 1/3rd the land required by PV.
* Produces heat at temperatures between 700-1,100°C
  (1,292°F-2,012°F), for multiple industrial applications.

[Read More ][16]

## PV (PhotoVoltaics)
* High land requirements/costs
* Lower solar efficiency ratios
* Intermittency and high storage costs
* (no 24/7 electricity generation)
* Incapable of providing high temperatures needed
* for industrial process heat applications

## ASC
* 1/6th the land requirements of PV
* High solar to electric efficiency
* 24/7 storage capabilities
* High heat capacity for various industries:
  * Cement / Calcining
  * Metal Processing eg. Steel & Aluminum
  * Green Hydrogen / Syngas
  * Water desalination
  * Food Processing

## Who We Are

UTOPIO is a minority-owned American renewable energy technology and design company. Founded in 2017,
UTOPIO is headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey with offices in New York and Georgia.

We’re not your typical energy company. UTOPIO utilizes innovative and disruptive renewable
technologies to satisfy our client's specific needs.

The exceptionally high temperatures we produce:
* Create heat and storage that ensure consistent electricity supply
* Produce broad spectrum industrial process heat 
* Generate green hydrogen efficiently through thermolysis
* Reclaim and desalinate waste and salt water

UTOPIO is the future of energy – an affordable and sustainable solution to providing carbon neutral
(if not negative) energy and water that is affordable and reliable.

[Learn More ][13]

## Our Industry Partnerships

UTOPIO ASC has the network and reach in the energy industry. Our partnerships with the National
Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), the Solar Energy Industry Association (SEIA), and the City
College of New York (CCNY) give us the ability to forge relationships with key players in the space,
stay informed of cutting-edge research, and gain insight into the latest solar energy deals.
1. UTOPIO ASC has nurtured varied relationships in the industry.
2. The UTOPIO ASC power plants are easy to assemble, to low cost, low risk and reproducible.


[See our Partnerships/Relationships here ][14]

## UTOPIO Difference


Our disruptive technology improved over decades of mechanical engineering design research... this
ASC technology is protected by 16 internationally registered patents.


UTOPIO ASC powered by ASC technology produces 3x the heat on only 20% of the land required by
traditional CSP technologies (Parabolic Trough / Solar Tower) and 33% of the land required for PV
(photovoltaic) resulting in significantly lower CAPEX and operational costs while featuring
modularity and scalability.


While existing CSP technologies (including Heliostat Towers, Linear Troughs, and Parabolic Troughs)
are only cost-effective at utility-level applications, UTOPIO ASC powered by ASC technology is
uniquely modular and scalable. This allows us to effectively and affordably power industrial and
microgrid projects as small as 30kW to as large as 50MW. This technology affords reliable and
cost-effective power solutions to individual factories, hotels, remote installations, etc.


The modular nature of our projects not only requires significantly less acreage to produce a given
amount of energy and heat, but the land need not be contiguous. Thus, construction and operation on
terrains, such as rocky hillsides, coastal easements, non-contiguous municipal lots, etc., opens up
broader opportunities previously unobtainable by CSP.

Learn more

UTOPIO can play a critical role in any corporation's or municipality's clean energy mix.

1. Zero-Carbon Footprint Electrical Production
2. Solar Industrial Process Heat
3. Production or clean-source support for Green Hydrogen
4. Fossil Fuel Power Plant Hybridization
5. Water Desalination

## ASC

The ASC is a new technology in Solar Energy that combines the advantages of PV and CSP while
eliminating the problems.

[Read More ][15]

## ASC Solution
* ASC's technology provides the industrial process heating capabilities of conventional CSP coupled
  with the modularity of PV (photovoltaic).
* Ultra-high solar efficiency with a solar-electrical conversion between 40%-50%, the highest in
  history.
* Low-cost long duration energy storage for 24/7/365 production.
* Uses 1/3rd the land required by PV.
* Produces heat at temperatures between 700-1,100°C
  (1,292°F-2,012°F), for multiple industrial applications.

[Read More ][16]

## PV (PhotoVoltaics)
* High land requirements/costs
* Lower solar efficiency ratios
* Intermittency and high storage costs
* (no 24/7 electricity generation)
* Incapable of providing high temperatures needed
* for industrial process heat applications

## ASC
* 1/6th the land requirements of PV
* High solar to electric efficiency
* 24/7 storage capabilities
* High heat capacity for various industries:
  * Cement / Calcining
  * Metal Processing eg. Steel & Aluminum
  * Green Hydrogen / Syngas
  * Water desalination
  * Food Processing
  * Mining
  * Lumber
  * Glass

## PV (PhotoVoltaics)
1. Collects: Large sun-tracking mirrors, called heliostats, concentrate sunlight onto a receiver at
   the top of the tower. 
2. Heats: The thermal energy heats a filler material, such as molten salt, which then heats a
   working fluid.
3. Stores: Thermal energy is stored in the molten salt, so it can be used for electricity generation
   as needed.
4. Generates: The working fluid, water, is heated to power a steam turbine, generating electricity.
5. Distributes: Electricity is sent to the grid on demand.

## Hybridization & Augmentation
* Hybridization & Augmentation (Rotating diagram)
* CSP uses solar thermal energy to produce steam, which in turn is used to generate electricity. The
  creation of steam as a byproduct gives CSP unmatched versatility and compatibility in the field of
  renewable technology, since CSP can share the hardware of traditional fossil based (i.e. coal,
  natural gas, biofuel) plants, which also utilize steam to generate electricity.
* In the United States alone, between 11 and 21 gigawatts of CSP could be built and integrated into
  existing fossil fuel plants in the United States to reduce their carbon emissions – that’s enough
  electricity to power between 3 million and 6 million homes.

## Grid Stability & Resilience
* As demand for electricity increases, existing utilities more frequently approach their limits for
  grid stability. CSP plants and thermal energy storage (TES) solutions can be used to provide
  on-demand clean energy to alleviate stress upon the grid and optimize electricity production
  during peak hours.

[Advanced search][14]

Webthesis portal gives access to the electronic archive of Politecnico's Master's degree theses and
meritorious theses in Architecture.

You can find in full text format:
* Master's degree theses of the courses in Cinema and Media Engineering, Electrical Engineering,
  Territorial, Urban, Environmental and Landscape Planning discussed in July 2017 (Academic Year
  2016/17);
* Most of the Master's degree theses discussed in the graduation session of October and December
  2017 (AY 2017/18);
* Master's theses of Politecnico discussed from 2018 on (AY 2017/2018).

Webthesis includes also records with abstracts for:
* The meritorious theses in Architecture discussed since 1996;
* All the Master's theses in Architecture discussed since 2010 with bibliography, index of chapters
  and tables.

Bibliographic data of the theses delivered to the Registrar's Office in electronic format and not
authorized to public consultation are also included (full-text not available).

Refer to the [contact][15] page to request changes to the accessibility of the theses.

Webthesis portal gives access to the electronic archive of Politecnico's Master's degree theses and
meritorious theses in Architecture.

You can find in full text format:
* Master's degree theses of the courses in Cinema and Media Engineering, Electrical Engineering,
  Territorial, Urban, Environmental and Landscape Planning discussed in July 2017 (Academic Year
  2016/17);
* Most of the Master's degree theses discussed in the graduation session of October and December
  2017 (AY 2017/18);
* Master's theses of Politecnico discussed from 2018 on (AY 2017/2018).

Webthesis includes also records with abstracts for:
* The meritorious theses in Architecture discussed since 1996;
* All the Master's theses in Architecture discussed since 2010 with bibliography, index of chapters
  and tables.

Bibliographic data of the theses delivered to the Registrar's Office in electronic format and not
authorized to public consultation are also included (full-text not available).

Refer to the [contact][15] page to request changes to the accessibility of the theses.
